description: This file defines an Android activity class 'CacheAbuser' which provides a user interface with buttons to start and stop resource-consuming tasks that generate cache files in internal or external storage. The tasks involve writing large amounts of data to simulate cache abuse for testing or benchmarking purposes.

classes.name: CacheAbuser
classes.description: Main activity class providing UI controls to start and stop cache abuse operations.

classes.name: AbuseTask
classes.description: Inner class extending AsyncTask to perform continuous file writing in the background for cache abuse simulation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up buttons and their click listeners.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Updates button states when activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops ongoing abuse tasks when activity is no longer visible.

methods.name: stopAbuse
methods.description: Cancels ongoing abuse tasks and updates UI button states.

methods.name: updateButtonState
methods.description: Enables or disables buttons based on current task status.
